headline: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has received In-Principal approval for Listing of Equity Shares pursuant to conversion of warrants issued on a preferential basis.
